points: New Confidential Bare Metal option lets model builders run their own host stack on third-party racks with encrypted transit and hardware access controls
Supported on GB300/Grace Blackwell NVL72 and HGX/DGX Rubin NVL8; Google Cloud A4X Max named
CoreWeave, Azure, Google Cloud, Lambda, Nebius, Nscale, Vultr and others signed up; Cohere to use it in Model Vault
take: Confidential computing now covers bare metal, containers and VMs on Blackwell and Rubin, with ten clouds signed up. Model and data stay sealed from the host. Vendor claims, no benchmarks.
title: NVIDIA: Confidential Bare Metal lets model builders rent GPUs privately
